programs.title: The Hunter's Prayer
programs.desc: (2017) High-octane thriller starring Sam Worthington. An assassin hired to kill a young woman ends up falling for her instead. Together, they team up to avenge her father's death.

programs.title: Master Gardener
programs.desc: (2022) Thriller with Joel Edgerton and Sigourney Weaver. A horticulturist's ordered life is thrown into chaos when he takes on an apprentice. As dark secrets surface, rules are about to be broken...

programs.title: Redemption Day
programs.desc: (2021) Action thriller with Gary Dourdan, Serinda Swan and Andy Garcia. A war hero embarks on a daring rescue mission when his wife is kidnapped. As the clock counts down, can he get to her in time?

programs.title: Kentucky Rifle
programs.desc: (1955) Suspenseful western with Chill Wills, Lance Fuller and Cathy Downs. When a gun-filled wagon breaks down in enemy territory, will its occupants surrender their cargo or fight for their lives?
